mapper.insert: INSERT INTO feed_items (item_type, item_id, author_id, published_at, province_code, place_id, place_group, sub_types, point, has_photo, photo_count, text_len, author_trust, eligible, stats_dirty, indexed_at) SELECT 'CHECKIN', c.id, c.user_id, c.created_at, COALESCE((SELECT w.province_code FROM wards w WHERE w.code = c.ward_code), p.province_code, c.province_code, goroute_province_at(COALESCE(p.latitude, c.latitude), COALESCE(p.longitude, c.longitude))), c.place_id, p.place_group, COALESCE(p.sub_types, '{}'::varchar[]), CASE WHEN p.latitude IS NOT NULL AND p.longitude IS NOT NULL THEN goroute_point(p.latitude, p.longitude) WHEN c.latitude IS NOT NULL AND c.longitude IS NOT NULL THEN goroute_point(c.latitude, c.longitude) END, c.has_photo, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM media_assets ma WHERE ma.entity_type = 'USER_CHECKIN' AND ma.entity_id = c.id AND (ma.asset_role IS NULL OR ma.asset_role = 'PHOTO') AND ma.deleted_at IS NULL), COALESCE(LENGTH(TRIM(c.caption)), 0), COALESCE((SELECT urp.trust_score FROM user_review_profiles urp WHERE urp.user_id = c.user_id), 50), (c.visibility = 'PUBLIC' AND c.is_removed = FALSE AND u.deleted_at IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM content_takedowns t WHERE t.content_type = 'CHECKIN' AND t.content_id = c.id AND t.restored_at IS NULL)), TRUE, NOW() FROM user_checkins c JOIN users u ON u.id = c.user_id LEFT JOIN places p ON p.id = c.place_id WHERE c.id IN ON CONFLICT (item_type, item_id) DO UPDATE SET author_id = EXCLUDED.author_id, published_at = EXCLUDED.published_at, province_code = EXCLUDED.province_code, place_id = EXCLUDED.place_id, place_group = EXCLUDED.place_group, sub_types = EXCLUDED.sub_types, point = EXCLUDED.point, has_photo = EXCLUDED.has_photo, photo_count = EXCLUDED.photo_count, text_len = EXCLUDED.text_len, author_trust = EXCLUDED.author_trust, eligible = EXCLUDED.eligible, stats_dirty = TRUE, indexed_at = NOW()

INSERT INTO feed_items (item_type, item_id, author_id, published_at, province_code, place_id, place_group, sub_types, point, has_photo, photo_count, text_len, author_trust, eligible, stats_dirty, indexed_at) SELECT 'REVIEW', r.id, r.user_id, r.created_at, COALESCE(p.province_code, goroute_province_at(COALESCE(p.latitude, r.checkin_lat), COALESCE(p.longitude, r.checkin_lng))), r.place_id, p.place_group, COALESCE(p.sub_types, '{}'::varchar[]), CASE WHEN p.latitude IS NOT NULL AND p.longitude IS NOT NULL THEN goroute_point(p.latitude, p.longitude) WHEN r.checkin_lat IS NOT NULL AND r.checkin_lng IS NOT NULL THEN goroute_point(r.checkin_lat, r.checkin_lng) END, r.has_photo, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM media_assets ma WHERE ma.entity_type = 'USER_REVIEW' AND ma.entity_id = r.id AND ma.deleted_at IS NULL), COALESCE(LENGTH(TRIM(r.text)), 0), COALESCE((SELECT urp.trust_score FROM user_review_profiles urp WHERE urp.user_id = r.user_id), 50), (u.deleted_at IS NULL AND (NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(r.text, '')), '') IS NOT NULL OR r.has_photo) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM content_takedowns t WHERE t.content_type = 'REVIEW' AND t.content_id = r.id AND t.restored_at IS NULL) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM user_checkins c WHERE c.review_id = r.id AND c.visibility = 'PUBLIC' AND c.is_removed = FALSE)), TRUE, NOW() FROM user_reviews r JOIN users u ON u.id = r.user_id LEFT JOIN places p ON p.id = r.place_id WHERE r.id IN ON CONFLICT (item_type, item_id) DO UPDATE SET author_id = EXCLUDED.author_id, published_at = EXCLUDED.published_at, province_code = EXCLUDED.province_code, place_id = EXCLUDED.place_id, place_group = EXCLUDED.place_group, sub_types = EXCLUDED.sub_types, point = EXCLUDED.point, has_photo = EXCLUDED.has_photo, photo_count = EXCLUDED.photo_count, text_len = EXCLUDED.text_len, author_trust = EXCLUDED.author_trust, eligible = EXCLUDED.eligible, stats_dirty = TRUE, indexed_at = NOW()

INSERT INTO feed_items (item_type, item_id, author_id, published_at, province_code, place_id, place_group, sub_types, point, has_photo, photo_count, text_len, author_trust, stop_count, linked_stop_count, day_count, has_cover, has_cost, trip_end_date, stop_kind_counts, copy_count, eligible, stats_dirty, indexed_at) SELECT 'TRIP', t.id, t.owner_id, COALESCE(t.public_shared_at, t.created_at), goroute_province_at(pt.lat, pt.lng), NULL, NULL, '{}'::varchar[], CASE WHEN pt.lat IS NOT NULL AND pt.lng IS NOT NULL THEN goroute_point(pt.lat, pt.lng) END, COALESCE(t.memory_count, 0) > 0, COALESCE(t.memory_count, 0), COALESCE(LENGTH(TRIM(t.description)), 0), COALESCE((SELECT urp.trust_score FROM user_review_profiles urp WHERE urp.user_id = t.owner_id), 50), stops.stop_count, stops.linked_count, CASE WHEN t.start_date IS NOT NULL AND t.end_date IS NOT NULL THEN GREATEST(1, t.end_date - t.start_date + 1) ELSE 0 END, NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(t.cover_image_url, '')), '') IS NOT NULL, (COALESCE(t.budget, 0) > 0 OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM expenses e WHERE e.trip_id = t.id)), t.end_date, kinds.counts, COALESCE(t.copy_count, 0), (t.visibility = 'PUBLIC' AND t.is_deleted = FALSE AND u.deleted_at IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM content_takedowns ct WHERE ct.content_type = 'TRIP' AND ct.content_id = t.id AND ct.restored_at IS NULL)), TRUE, NOW() FROM trips t JOIN users u ON u.id = t.owner_id LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT d.lat, d.lng FROM trip_destinations d WHERE d.trip_id = t.id AND d.lat IS NOT NULL AND d.lng IS NOT NULL ORDER BY d.is_primary DESC NULLS LAST, d.order_index NULLS LAST LIMIT 1 ) dest ON TRUE CROSS JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT COALESCE(dest.lat, t.destination_lat) AS lat, COALESCE(dest.lng, t.destination_lng) AS lng ) pt CROSS JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS stop_count, COUNT(a.place_ref_id) AS linked_count FROM activities a WHERE a.trip_id = t.id AND COALESCE(a.status, '') <> 'REJECTED' ) stops LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT jsonb_object_agg(grouped.kind, grouped.n) AS counts FROM ( SELECT kind, COUNT(*) AS n FROM ( SELECT p.place_group AS kind FROM activities a JOIN places p ON p.id = a.place_ref_id WHERE a.trip_id = t.id AND COALESCE(a.status, '') <> 'REJECTED' AND p.place_group IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT unnest(p.sub_types) AS kind FROM activities a JOIN places p ON p.id = a.place_ref_id WHERE a.trip_id = t.id AND COALESCE(a.status, '') <> 'REJECTED' ) every_kind GROUP BY kind ) grouped ) kinds ON TRUE WHERE t.id IN ON CONFLICT (item_type, item_id) DO UPDATE SET author_id = EXCLUDED.author_id, published_at = EXCLUDED.published_at, province_code = EXCLUDED.province_code, point = EXCLUDED.point, has_photo = EXCLUDED.has_photo, photo_count = EXCLUDED.photo_count, text_len = EXCLUDED.text_len, author_trust = EXCLUDED.author_trust, stop_count = EXCLUDED.stop_count, linked_stop_count = EXCLUDED.linked_stop_count, day_count = EXCLUDED.day_count, has_cover = EXCLUDED.has_cover, has_cost = EXCLUDED.has_cost, trip_end_date = EXCLUDED.trip_end_date, stop_kind_counts = EXCLUDED.stop_kind_counts, copy_count = EXCLUDED.copy_count, eligible = EXCLUDED.eligible, stats_dirty = TRUE, indexed_at = NOW()
mapper.delete:
DELETE FROM feed_items fi WHERE fi.item_type = #{itemType} AND fi.item_id IN AND NOT EXISTS (
SELECT 1 FROM user_checkins s WHERE s.id = fi.item_id SELECT 1 FROM user_reviews s WHERE s.id = fi.item_id SELECT 1 FROM trips s WHERE s.id = fi.item_id )
mapper.update: UPDATE feed_items fi SET stats_dirty = TRUE FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT item_type, item_id FROM feed_impressions WHERE last_seen_at > #{since} ) seen WHERE fi.item_type = seen.item_type AND fi.item_id = seen.item_id AND NOT fi.stats_dirty
mapper.select: SELECT item_type, item_id, NULL AS queued_at FROM feed_items WHERE stats_dirty ORDER BY indexed_at LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE feed_items fi SET like_count = CASE fi.item_type WHEN 'CHECKIN' THEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_checkin_likes l WHERE l.checkin_id = fi.item_id) WHEN 'REVIEW' THEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM review_helpful_votes v WHERE v.review_id = fi.item_id AND v.is_helpful) ELSE (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM trip_helpful_votes v WHERE v.trip_id = fi.item_id AND v.is_helpful) END, comment_count = (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT cc.user_id) FROM content_comments cc WHERE cc.content_type = fi.item_type AND cc.content_id = fi.item_id AND cc.is_deleted = FALSE AND cc.user_id <> fi.author_id), save_count = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM saved_posts sp WHERE sp.post_type = fi.item_type AND sp.post_id = fi.item_id), impression_count = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM feed_impressions i WHERE i.item_type = fi.item_type AND i.item_id = fi.item_id), hide_count = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM feed_feedback ff WHERE ff.kind = 'HIDE_POST' AND ff.item_type = fi.item_type AND ff.item_id = fi.item_id AND ff.revoked_at IS NULL), report_count = (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT r.reporter_id) FROM content_reports r WHERE r.content_type = fi.item_type AND r.content_id = fi.item_id AND COALESCE(r.status, '') <> 'DISMISSED'), stats_dirty = FALSE, stats_updated_at = NOW() WHERE (fi.item_type, fi.item_id) IN
mapper.select: SELECT FROM feed_items fi WHERE (fi.item_type, fi.item_id) IN
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO feed_index_queue (item_type, item_id, queued_at) SELECT item_type, item_id, NOW() FROM feed_items WHERE published_at > #{recentSince} OR stats_updated_at IS NULL OR stats_updated_at < #{staleBefore} ON CONFLICT (item_type, item_id) DO UPDATE SET queued_at = EXCLUDED.queued_at
